def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    A = int(data[0]); B = int(data[1]); M = int(data[2])

    # The answer is symmetric in A and B (complementing the permutation swaps
    # LIS and LDS, and maps n+0.5 to another half-integer). Keep B = min(A,B)
    # so the inner DP loop (over rows) is as short as possible.
    if A < B:
        A, B = B, A

    N = A * B - 1

    # By RSK, permutations of length AB-1 with LIS = A and LDS = B correspond to
    # pairs (P-tableau, Q-tableau) of SYT of the same shape lam with lam_1 = A,
    # B rows and AB-1 cells => lam = (A, A, ..., A, A-1)  (B rows).
    lam = [A] * (B - 1) + [A - 1]

    # Third condition: appending n+0.5 must keep LIS = A and LDS = B, i.e. the
    # RSK shape becomes the full A x B rectangle: a new box at (B, A).
    # Inserting y bumps a chain whose columns weakly decrease and which must end
    # at column A, so the whole bumping path lies in column A. Taking y maximal
    # (just below T[1][A]) this is possible iff
    #     T[i][A-1] < T[i-1][A]   for i = 2..B.
    # That depends only on the P-tableau, so
    #     answer = (#valid P-tableaux) * f^lam.

    # f^lam by the hook length formula (exact integers, then reduced mod M).
    prod = 1
    for i in range(B):
        li = lam[i]
        for j in range(li):
            leg = 0
            for r in range(i + 1, B):
                if lam[r] > j:
                    leg += 1
            prod *= (li - j - 1) + leg + 1
    fm = (factorial(N) // prod) % M

    # Count SYT of lam with the extra relations, by growing the diagram cell by
    # cell.  "T[i][A-1] filled before T[i-1][A]" means no intermediate shape mu
    # may have mu[r] == A while mu[r+1] < A-1.
    Am1 = A - 1
    rows = tuple(range(B))
    lam_t = tuple(lam)
    cur = {(0,) * B: 1}
    for _ in range(N):
        nxt = {}
        get = nxt.get
        for shape, val in cur.items():
            prev = A + 1
            for r in rows:
                sr = shape[r]
                if sr < lam_t[r] and sr < prev:
                    ns = sr + 1
                    if ns != A or r + 1 >= B or shape[r + 1] >= Am1:
                        new = shape[:r] + (ns,) + shape[r + 1:]
                        v = get(new)
                        nxt[new] = val if v is None else (v + val) % M
                prev = sr
        cur = nxt

    C = cur.get(lam_t, 0)
    sys.stdout.write(str(C * fm % M) + "\n")

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    A = int(data[0]); B = int(data[1]); M = int(data[2])
    N = A * B - 1

    # By RSK: permutations of length AB-1 with LIS=A, LDS=B correspond to pairs
    # (P-tableau, Q-tableau) of SYT of shape lam = (A^(B-1), A-1)  (the only
    # partition with at most B rows, first row A and AB-1 cells).
    # Appending n+0.5 must produce shape = full B x A rectangle, i.e. a bumping
    # chain of length B ending with a new box at (B, A).  By the row bumping
    # lemma the bumping route weakly moves left, and the new box sits in column
    # A, so the whole chain runs down column A.  That is possible for some n iff
    #     T[r][A] > T[r+1][A-1]   for r = 1 .. B-1
    # (and such an n always exists then, e.g. n = T[1][A]-1).
    # So the answer is f(lam) * g, with g = #SYT of lam obeying those relations.
    # Reading the tableau as a growth process, the relation says: row r may only
    # reach length A once row r+1 already has length A-1 -> a pure shape DP.

    lam = [A] * (B - 1) + [A - 1]

    conj = [0] * A
    for j in range(A):
        c = 0
        for i in range(B):
            if lam[i] > j:
                c += 1
        conj[j] = c

    den = 1
    for i in range(B):
        li = lam[i]
        for j in range(li):
            den *= (li - j) + (conj[j] - i) - 1
    f = factorial(N) // den
    f %= M

    Am1 = A - 1
    Bm1 = B - 1

    cur = {tuple([0] * B): 1}
    for _ in range(N):
        nxt = {}
        get = nxt.get
        for s, v in cur.items():
            prev = A
            for r in range(B):
                lr = s[r]
                if lr < prev:
                    if r < Bm1:
                        if lr < Am1 or s[r + 1] == Am1:
                            t = s[:r] + (lr + 1,) + s[r + 1:]
                            w = get(t)
                            nxt[t] = v if w is None else (w + v) % M
                    else:
                        if lr < Am1:
                            t = s[:r] + (lr + 1,)
                            w = get(t)
                            nxt[t] = v if w is None else (w + v) % M
                prev = lr
        cur = nxt

    g = cur.get(tuple(lam), 0) % M
    print(f * g % M)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1].decode() if isinstance(data[1], (bytes, bytearray)) else data[1]

    # sum_{i<=j} f(i,j) = sum_k d_k * k * (10^(N-k+1) - 1) / 9
    # => 9 * ANS = A - T,  with A = sum_k d_k*k*10^(N-k+1),  T = sum_k d_k*k
    # A is built directly as a decimal digit array (little endian) to avoid
    # quadratic big-int work.

    size = n + 12
    val = [0] * size
    T = 0
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        c = (ord(s[k - 1]) - 48) * k
        T += c
        val[n - k + 1] += c

    # carry propagation
    carry = 0
    for p in range(size):
        t = val[p] + carry
        val[p] = t % 10
        carry = t // 10
    while carry:
        val.append(carry % 10)
        carry //= 10

    # subtract T
    borrow = 0
    i = 0
    while T > 0 or borrow:
        cur = val[i] - (T % 10) - borrow
        T //= 10
        if cur < 0:
            cur += 10
            borrow = 1
        else:
            borrow = 0
        val[i] = cur
        i += 1

    # locate most significant digit
    hi = len(val) - 1
    while hi > 0 and val[hi] == 0:
        hi -= 1

    # divide by 9 (long division, most significant first)
    out = []
    rem = 0
    for p in range(hi, -1, -1):
        cur = rem * 10 + val[p]
        out.append(cur // 9)
        rem = cur % 9

    res = ''.join(map(str, out)).lstrip('0')
    sys.stdout.write(res if res else '0')
    sys.stdout.write('\n')

    H = [0] * (n + 2)
    for i in range(n):
        H[i + 1] = int(data[2 + i])

    # Queries bucketed by l using an intrusive linked list (fast, no list-of-lists).
    head = [0] * (n + 2)
    nxt = [0] * (q + 1)
    QR = [0] * (q + 1)
    idx = 2 + n
    for k in range(1, q + 1):
        l = int(data[idx])
        r = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2
        QR[k] = r
        nxt[k] = head[l]
        head[l] = k

    # Key fact: x > r visible from l  =>  x visible from r (the blocking range of l
    # contains that of r). So the answer is just #{x > r : x visible from l}.
    # The set visible from l is the strictly increasing "record" chain starting at l+1.
    # Sweep l from N-1 down to 1 keeping that chain on a stack (top = smallest index)
    # and its indices in a BIT, then answer queries offline.
    tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    ans = [0] * (q + 1)
    stack = []
    cnt = 0

    for l in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        p = l + 1
        h = H[p]
        while stack and H[stack[-1]] < h:
            j = stack.pop()
            cnt -= 1
            i = j
            while i <= n:
                tree[i] -= 1
                i += i & -i
        stack.append(p)
        cnt += 1
        i = p
        while i <= n:
            tree[i] += 1
            i += i & -i

        k = head[l]
        while k:
            r = QR[k]
            s = 0
            i = r
            while i > 0:
                s += tree[i]
                i -= i & -i
            ans[k] = cnt - s
            k = nxt[k]

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(map(str, ans[1:])))

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    H = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))

    rs = [0] * q
    heads = [-1] * (n + 2)
    nxtq = [-1] * q
    it = map(int, data[2 + n:2 + n + 2 * q])
    for t in range(q):
        l = next(it)
        r = next(it)
        rs[t] = r
        i = l + 1
        nxtq[t] = heads[i]
        heads[i] = t

    ans = [0] * q
    # Monotonic stack swept from east to west.
    # After pushing i, the stack holds exactly the positions j >= i that are
    # visible from i-1 (no building taller than H_j strictly between i-1 and j).
    # Positions are stored negated so the list stays sorted ascending and the
    # count of positions > r is a single bisect.
    negstack = []
    hstack = []
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        hi = H[i - 1]
        while hstack and hstack[-1] < hi:
            hstack.pop()
            negstack.pop()
        hstack.append(hi)
        negstack.append(-i)
        t = heads[i]
        while t != -1:
            ans[t] = bisect_left(negstack, -rs[t])
            t = nxtq[t]

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(map(str, ans)) + '\n')

    try:
        import numpy as np
    except Exception:
        np = None

    pow3 = [3 ** k for k in range(W + 2)]

    # Frontier state = W digits base 3, digit k = colour of frontier position k.
    # Before processing column j of a row, the frontier is
    #   [current row cols 0..j-1] + [previous row cols j..W-1]
    # so every adjacent pair is constrained EXCEPT the pair (j-1, j).
    def gen(free_pair):
        cur = [(c, c) for c in range(3)]
        for pos in range(1, W):
            p = pow3[pos]
            constrained = (pos - 1 != free_pair)
            nxt = []
            for s, last in cur:
                for c in range(3):
                    if constrained and c == last:
                        continue
                    nxt.append((s + c * p, c))
            cur = nxt
        return [s for s, _ in cur]

    states = [gen(j - 1) for j in range(W)]
    states.append(states[0])           # after the last column: all pairs constrained
    sizes = [len(x) for x in states]

    # For every column j precompute (independently of the row) the "gather" tables:
    # for each destination state d in states[j+1] with d[j] == c, the source states
    # in states[j] that map onto it.  Each d has exactly 1 or 2 sources.
    tables = []
    for j in range(W):
        pj = pow3[j]
        pj1 = pow3[j + 1]
        smap = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(states[j])}
        dsts = states[j + 1]
        last_col = (j == W - 1)
        d1 = [[], [], []]; s1 = [[], [], []]
        d2 = [[], [], []]; s2a = [[], [], []]; s2b = [[], [], []]
        for di, d in enumerate(dsts):
            c = (d // pj) % 3
            base = d - c * pj
            nb = -1 if last_col else (d // pj1) % 3
            if nb < 0 or nb == c:
                a = (c + 1) % 3
                b = (c + 2) % 3
                d2[c].append(di)
                s2a[c].append(smap[base + a * pj])
                s2b[c].append(smap[base + b * pj])
            else:
                u = 3 - c - nb
                d1[c].append(di)
                s1[c].append(smap[base + u * pj])
        del smap
        if np is not None:
            def conv(L):
                return [np.array(x, dtype=np.int64) for x in L]
            tables.append((conv(d1), conv(s1), conv(d2), conv(s2a), conv(s2b)))
        else:
            tables.append((d1, s1, d2, s2a, s2b))

    allowed = []
    for i in range(H):
        row = []
        gi = grid[i]
        for j in range(W):
            ch = gi[j]
            row.append((0, 1, 2) if ch == '?' else (int(ch) - 1,))
        allowed.append(row)

    # Row 0: no cell above, only the horizontal constraints (already in states[0]).
    n0 = sizes[0]
    dp = [0] * n0
    a0 = allowed[0]
    for i0, s in enumerate(states[0]):
        t = s
        ok = True
        for k in range(W):
            if (t % 3) not in a0[k]:
                ok = False
                break
            t //= 3
        if ok:
            dp[i0] = 1

    del states

    if np is not None:
        dp = np.array(dp, dtype=np.int64)
        for i in range(1, H):
            ai = allowed[i]
            for j in range(W):
                d1, s1, d2, s2a, s2b = tables[j]
                ndp = np.zeros(sizes[j + 1], dtype=np.int64)
                for c in ai[j]:
                    dd = d1[c]
                    if dd.size:
                        ndp[dd] = dp[s1[c]]
                    dd = d2[c]
                    if dd.size:
                        ndp[dd] = (dp[s2a[c]] + dp[s2b[c]]) % MOD
                dp = ndp
        sys.stdout.write(str(int(dp.sum() % MOD)) + "\n")
    else:
        for i in range(1, H):
            ai = allowed[i]
            for j in range(W):
                d1, s1, d2, s2a, s2b = tables[j]
                ndp = [0] * sizes[j + 1]
                for c in ai[j]:
                    dd = d1[c]; ss = s1[c]
                    for t in range(len(dd)):
                        ndp[dd[t]] = dp[ss[t]]
                    dd = d2[c]; sa = s2a[c]; sb = s2b[c]
                    for t in range(len(dd)):
                        ndp[dd[t]] = (dp[sa[t]] + dp[sb[t]]) % MOD
                dp = ndp
        sys.stdout.write(str(sum(dp) % MOD) + "\n")

import numpy as np


def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    H = int(data[0])
    W = int(data[1])
    rows = [data[2 + i].decode() for i in range(H)]

    # Trabajar con W = min(H, W) <= 14  (porque H*W <= 200)
    if W > H:
        rows = [''.join(rows[i][j] for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)]
        H, W = W, H

    fixed = [[-1 if ch == '?' else int(ch) - 1 for ch in r] for r in rows]

    # Codificacion de secuencias validas (adyacentes distintos) de longitud L:
    # indice = d0 * 2^(L-1) + t_1*2^(L-2) + ... + t_{L-1}, donde el digito k+1
    # es (d_k + 1 + t_{k+1}) % 3.  Hay 3*2^(L-1) de ellas.
    seq = np.array([[0], [1], [2]], dtype=np.int64)
    for L in range(2, W + 1):
        n = seq.shape[0]
        new = np.zeros((2 * n, L), dtype=np.int64)
        new[:, :L - 1] = np.repeat(seq, 2, axis=0)
        last = np.repeat(seq[:, L - 2], 2)
        t = np.tile(np.array([0, 1], dtype=np.int64), n)
        new[:, L - 1] = (last + 1 + t) % 3
        seq = new
    NR = seq.shape[0]  # 3*2^(W-1)

    # Fila 0: no hay restriccion vertical, solo las celdas fijas
    ok = np.ones(NR, dtype=bool)
    for j in range(W):
        d = fixed[0][j]
        if d >= 0:
            ok &= (seq[:, j] == d)
    dp = ok.astype(np.int64).reshape(1, NR)

    # Precomputo por columna j: primer digito del sufijo B y el agrupamiento
    # que resulta de descartar ese primer digito.
    stages = []
    for j in range(W):
        L = W - j
        nB = 3 << (L - 1)
        b = np.arange(nB, dtype=np.int64)
        bj = b >> (L - 1)
        if L >= 2:
            t1 = (b >> (L - 2)) & 1
            bnext = (bj + 1 + t1) % 3
            bprime = (bnext << (L - 2)) | (b & ((1 << (L - 2)) - 1))
            g = 2
        else:
            bprime = np.zeros(nB, dtype=np.int64)
            g = 3
        order = np.argsort(bprime, kind='stable')
        stages.append((bj[order], order, g, nB // g))

    for i in range(1, H):
        lastdig = None
        for j in range(W):
            bj_s, order, g, nBp = stages[j]
            dpp = dp[:, order]
            nA = dp.shape[0]
            d = fixed[i][j]
            if j == 0:
                dp_new = np.zeros((3, nBp), dtype=np.int64)
                for c in range(3):
                    if d >= 0 and c != d:
                        continue
                    m = (bj_s != c)
                    contrib = np.where(m[None, :], dpp, 0).reshape(nA, nBp, g).sum(axis=2)
                    dp_new[c] = contrib[0]
                lastdig = np.array([0, 1, 2], dtype=np.int64)
            else:
                dp_new = np.zeros((2 * nA, nBp), dtype=np.int64)
                newlast = np.zeros(2 * nA, dtype=np.int64)
                for t in range(2):
                    cv = (lastdig + 1 + t) % 3
                    newlast[t::2] = cv
                    m = cv[:, None] != bj_s[None, :]
                    if d >= 0:
                        m &= (cv[:, None] == d)
                    dp_new[t::2] = np.where(m, dpp, 0).reshape(nA, nBp, g).sum(axis=2)
                lastdig = newlast
            dp = dp_new % MOD
        dp = dp.reshape(1, NR)

    print(int(dp.sum() % MOD))

    # R[l]: extremo derecho del intervalo que empieza en l.
    # col[l]: color del intervalo que empieza en l.
    # cnt[c]: cantidad de celdas pintadas de color c.
    parent = list(range(n + 2))
    R = list(range(n + 2))
    col = list(range(n + 2))
    cnt = [1] * (n + 2)
    cnt[0] = 0
    if n + 1 <= n + 1:
        cnt[n + 1] = 0

    out = []
    idx = 2
    one = b'1'
    for _ in range(q):
        if data[idx] == one:
            x = int(data[idx + 1])
            c = int(data[idx + 2])
            idx += 3

            # find(x) con compresion de caminos (iterativo)
            l = x
            while parent[l] != l:
                parent[l] = parent[parent[l]]
                l = parent[l]

            old = col[l]
            if old == c:
                # el intervalo ya es maximal y del color pedido: nada que hacer
                continue

            r = R[l]
            sz = r - l + 1
            cnt[old] -= sz
            cnt[c] += sz
            col[l] = c

            # fusionar con el vecino de la izquierda si comparte color
            if l > 1:
                p = l - 1
                while parent[p] != p:
                    parent[p] = parent[parent[p]]
                    p = parent[p]
                if col[p] == c:
                    parent[l] = p
                    R[p] = r
                    l = p

            # fusionar con el vecino de la derecha si comparte color
            # (r+1 es extremo izquierdo, por lo tanto ya es raiz del DSU)
            if r < n:
                nb = r + 1
                if col[nb] == c:
                    parent[nb] = l
                    R[l] = R[nb]
        else:
            c = int(data[idx + 1])
            idx += 2
            out.append(cnt[c])

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); m = int(data[1]); l = int(data[2])
    p = 3
    A = [int(x) for x in data[p:p + n]]; p += n
    B = [int(x) for x in data[p:p + m]]; p += m
    C = [int(x) for x in data[p:p + l]]; p += l

    # All cards sorted ascending by value; owner 0 = Takahashi, 1 = Aoki, 2 = table
    cards = [(v, 0) for v in A] + [(v, 1) for v in B] + [(v, 2) for v in C]
    cards.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    S = len(cards)
    val = [c[0] for c in cards]

    maskT = 0
    maskA = 0
    for i, (v, who) in enumerate(cards):
        if who == 0:
            maskT |= 1 << i
        elif who == 1:
            maskA |= 1 << i
    FULL = (1 << S) - 1

    # lower[i] = mask of cards whose value is strictly less than val[i]
    lower = [0] * S
    acc = 0
    j = 0
    for i in range(S):
        while j < S and val[j] < val[i]:
            acc |= 1 << j
            j += 1
        lower[i] = acc

    memo = {}

    def win(h, o):
        """True if the player to move (hand mask h, opponent hand mask o) wins."""
        if h == 0:
            return False
        key = h | (o << S)
        r = memo.get(key)
        if r is not None:
            return r
        table = FULL ^ h ^ o
        res = False
        hh = h
        prev = None
        while hh:
            b = hh & -hh
            hh ^= b
            i = b.bit_length() - 1
            v = val[i]
            if v == prev:          # identical value already tried from hand
                continue
            prev = v
            nh = h ^ b
            newtable = table | b
            # Option 1: play and take nothing
            if not win(o, nh):
                res = True
                break
            # Option 2: play and take one strictly smaller card from the table
            cand = newtable & lower[i]
            prev2 = None
            while cand:
                c = cand & -cand
                cand ^= c
                k = c.bit_length() - 1
                v2 = val[k]
                if v2 == prev2:    # identical value already tried as a take
                    continue
                prev2 = v2
                if not win(o, nh | c):
                    res = True
                    break
            if res:
                break
        memo[key] = res
        return res

    print("Takahashi" if win(maskT, maskA) else "Aoki")

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); m = int(data[1]); l = int(data[2])
    K = n + m + l
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[3:3 + K]]

    # Sort cards by value so that equal values occupy contiguous bit positions.
    order = sorted(range(K), key=lambda i: nums[i])
    pos = [0] * K
    for newi, oldi in enumerate(order):
        pos[oldi] = newi
    vals = [nums[i] for i in order]

    my_init = 0
    for i in range(n):
        my_init |= 1 << pos[i]
    opp_init = 0
    for i in range(n, n + m):
        opp_init |= 1 << pos[i]

    full = (1 << K) - 1

    # less[i] = mask of cards whose value is strictly smaller than card i's value
    less = [0] * K
    for i in range(K):
        msk = 0
        vi = vals[i]
        for j in range(K):
            if vals[j] < vi:
                msk |= 1 << j
        less[i] = msk

    # Groups of equal values (contiguous because sorted)
    groups = []
    i = 0
    while i < K:
        j = i
        while j < K and vals[j] == vals[i]:
            j += 1
        groups.append((i, j - i, ((1 << (j - i)) - 1) << i))
        i = j
    dup = any(sz > 1 for _, sz, _ in groups)

    memo = {}

    def f(my, opp):
        # True if the player to move (holding hand `my`) wins.
        if my == 0:
            return 0
        if dup:
            nmy = 0
            nopp = 0
            for st, sz, gm in groups:
                a = bin(my & gm).count('1')
                b = bin(opp & gm).count('1')
                if a:
                    nmy |= ((1 << a) - 1) << st
                if b:
                    nopp |= ((1 << b) - 1) << (st + a)
            my = nmy
            opp = nopp
        key = (my << 12) | opp
        r = memo.get(key, -1)
        if r >= 0:
            return r
        table = full & ~(my | opp)
        res = 0
        mm = my
        lastv = -1
        while mm:
            b = mm & -mm
            mm ^= b
            i = b.bit_length() - 1
            v = vals[i]
            if v == lastv:
                continue
            lastv = v
            rest = my ^ b
            # Option 1: play card i and take nothing.
            if not f(opp, rest):
                res = 1
                break
            # Option 2: play card i and take a strictly smaller card from the table.
            cc = table & less[i]
            lv2 = -1
            found = False
            while cc:
                c2 = cc & -cc
                cc ^= c2
                j = c2.bit_length() - 1
                if vals[j] == lv2:
                    continue
                lv2 = vals[j]
                if not f(opp, rest | c2):
                    found = True
                    break
            if found:
                res = 1
                break
        memo[key] = res
        return res

    sys.stdout.write("Takahashi\n" if f(my_init, opp_init) else "Aoki\n")

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    n = int(data[0]); k = int(data[1])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]

    tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    inv_total = 0
    for idx in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        v = P[idx]
        i = v - 1
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += tree[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        inv_total += s
        i = v
        while i <= n:
            tree[i] += 1
            i += i & (-i)

    m = n - k + 1

    # ---- sum over all windows of the inversions inside the window ----
    tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    f = 0
    for idx in range(k):
        v = P[idx]
        i = v
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += tree[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        f += idx - s          # already inserted values greater than v
        i = v
        while i <= n:
            tree[i] += 1
            i += i & (-i)

    S = f
    km1 = k - 1
    for i in range(m - 1):
        v = P[i]
        # inversions where v is the left element of the window
        j = v - 1
        s = 0
        while j > 0:
            s += tree[j]
            j -= j & (-j)
        a = s
        # remove v from the window
        j = v
        while j <= n:
            tree[j] -= 1
            j += j & (-j)
        w = P[i + k]
        # inversions where w is the new right element
        j = w
        s = 0
        while j > 0:
            s += tree[j]
            j -= j & (-j)
        b = km1 - s
        j = w
        while j <= n:
            tree[j] += 1
            j += j & (-j)
        f = f - a + b
        S += f

    inv4 = pow(4, MOD - 2, MOD)
    invm = pow(m % MOD, MOD - 2, MOD)
    ans = (inv_total % MOD

    two = [0] * (n + 1)
    pos = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        ch = s[i - 1]
        one[i] = one[i - 1] + (1 if ch == '1' else 0)
        two[i] = two[i - 1] + (1 if ch == '2' else 0)
        if ch == '/':
            pos.append(i)

    for _ in range(q):
        L = int(data[idx])

        if lo > hi:
            out.append('0')
            continue

        oL = one[L - 1]
        tR = two[R]

        # f(j) = #'1' in [L, p-1] is non-decreasing in j
        # g(j) = #'2' in [p+1, R] is non-increasing in j
        # so f - g is non-decreasing: binary search the crossing point.
        a, b = lo, hi
        while a <= b:
            m = (a + b) >> 1
            p = pos[m]
            if one[p - 1] - oL > tR - two[p]:
                b = m - 1

        for j in (a - 1, a):
            if lo <= j <= hi:
                p = pos[j]
                f = one[p - 1] - oL
                g = tR - two[p]
                v = f if f < g else g

    c1 = []   # number of '1' strictly before that '/'
    c2 = []   # number of '2' strictly before that '/'
    D = []    # c1 + c2  (non-decreasing)

    a = 0
    b = 0
    for i in range(n):
        ch = s[i]
        if ch == '1':
            a += 1
        elif ch == '2':
            b += 1
        else:
            P.append(i + 1)
            c1.append(a)
            c2.append(b)
            D.append(a + b)
        pre1[i + 1] = a
        pre2[i + 1] = b

    out = []

        # ---- find the block containing column l (largest start <= l) ----
        w = l >> 6
        x = words[w] & ((1 << ((l & 63) + 1)) - 1)
        if x:
            s = (w << 6) + x.bit_length() - 1
        else:
            sm = summary & ((1 << w) - 1)
            w2 = sm.bit_length() - 1
            s = (w2 << 6) + words[w2].bit_length() - 1

        # ---- split at the left boundary if needed ----
        if s != l:
            e = endv[s]
            endv[s] = l - 1
            endv[l] = e
            valv[l] = valv[s]
            ww = l >> 6
            words[ww] |= 1 << (l & 63)
            summary |= 1 << ww

        # ---- scan blocks covering [l, r], taking the min free row ----
        m = valv[l]
        e = endv[l]
        cur = l
        while e < r:
            cur = e + 1
            v = valv[cur]
            if v < m:
                m = v
            e = endv[cur]
            ww = cur >> 6
            words[ww] &= ~(1 << (cur & 63))
            if not words[ww]:
                summary &= ~(1 << ww)

        # ---- split at the right boundary if needed ----
        if e > r:
            k = r + 1
            endv[k] = e
            valv[k] = valv[cur]
            ww = k >> 6
            words[ww] |= 1 << (k & 63)
            summary |= 1 << ww

        # ---- the bar rests on row m; [l, r] becomes one block with m-1 ----
        endv[l] = r
        valv[l] = m - 1
        ans[i] = m

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(map(str, ans)) + "\n")

    # sum_{i<=j} (A_i + A_j) = (n+1) * S
    ans = (n + 1) * S

    K = mx.bit_length() - 1  # largest k with 2^k <= max possible pair sum

    try:
        import numpy as np
    except ImportError:
        np = None

    if np is not None:
        Anp = np.array(A, dtype=np.int64)
        for k in range(1, K + 1):

            mask = m - 1
            keys = Anp & mask
            u, c = np.unique(keys, return_counts=True)
            tgt = (m - keys) & mask
            idx = np.searchsorted(u, tgt)
            idx_c = np.minimum(idx, len(u) - 1)
            valid = u[idx_c] == tgt
            cc = np.where(valid, c[idx_c], 0).astype(np.int64)
            X = int((Anp * cc).sum())
            half_mask = (1 << (k - 1)) - 1
            Dsum = int(Anp[(Anp & half_mask) == 0].sum())
            ans -= (X + Dsum) >> k
    else:
        for k in range(1, K + 1):
            m = 1 << k
            mask = m - 1
            cnt = {}
            for a in A:
                r = a & mask
                if r in cnt:
                    cnt[r] += 1
                else:
                    cnt[r] = 1
            g = cnt.get
            X = 0
            for a in A:
                X += a * g((m - (a & mask)) & mask, 0)
            half_mask = (1 << (k - 1)) - 1
            Dsum = 0
            for a in A:
                if not (a & half_mask):
                    Dsum += a
            ans -= (X + Dsum) >> k

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")

import sys
import numpy as np


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    A = np.array(list(map(int, data[1:1 + n])), dtype=np.int64)

    max_pair_sum = 2 * int(A.max())

    # f(x) = x - sum_{t>=1, 2^t | x} x / 2^t
    # So: answer = T_0 - sum_{t>=1} T_t / 2^t
    # where T_t = sum over pairs i<=j with 2^t | (A_i+A_j) of (A_i+A_j)
    total = 0
    t = 0
    while True:
        M = 1 << t
        if t > 0 and M > max_pair_sum:
            break
        mask = M - 1
        r = A & mask  # t == 0 -> mask == 0 -> all residues 0

        order = np.argsort(r, kind='stable')
        rs = r[order]
        As = A[order]

        # group boundaries of equal residues
        starts = np.flatnonzero(
            np.concatenate((np.array([True]), rs[1:] != rs[:-1]))
        )
        bounds = np.append(starts, n)
        u = rs[starts]
        cnt = np.diff(bounds)
        csum = np.concatenate((np.zeros(1, dtype=np.int64), np.cumsum(As)))
        ssum = csum[bounds[1:]] - csum[bounds[:-1]]

        k = len(u)
        p = (M - u) & mask  # partner residue: r + p == 0 (mod M)
        pos = np.searchsorted(u, p)
        posc = np.minimum(pos, k - 1)
        exists = u[posc] == p
        self_m = (p == u)

        Tt = 0
        if self_m.any():
            # pairs inside one class (r == -r mod M), i <= j including i == j
            Tt += int(((cnt[self_m] + 1) * ssum[self_m]).sum())
        cross = exists & (~self_m) & (u < p)
        if cross.any():
            pp = posc[cross]
            Tt += int((cnt[pp] * ssum[cross] + cnt[cross] * ssum[pp]).sum())

        if t == 0:
            total += Tt
        else:
            total -= Tt >> t
        t += 1

    sys.stdout.write(str(total) + "\n")

import numpy as np


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    n = int(data[ptr]); ptr += 1
    A = np.array(list(map(int, data[ptr:ptr + n])), dtype=np.int64); ptr += n
    B = np.array(list(map(int, data[ptr:ptr + n])), dtype=np.int64); ptr += n
    k = int(data[ptr]); ptr += 1
    xy = np.array(list(map(int, data[ptr:ptr + 2 * k])), dtype=np.int64)
    X = np.ascontiguousarray(xy[0::2])
    Y = np.ascontiguousarray(xy[1::2])

    # block size balancing the sweeps (O((n/b)*n)) against the cross terms (O(k*b))
    bsz = int(n * (2.0 / k) ** 0.5 * 1.5) + 1
    if bsz > n:
        bsz = n
    if bsz < 1:
        bsz = 1

    P = X // bsz
    Q = Y // bsz
    PB = P * bsz
    QB = Q * bsz

    ans = np.zeros(k, dtype=np.int64)

    ordA = np.argsort(A, kind='stable')
    As = A[ordA]
    ordB = np.argsort(B, kind='stable')
    Bs = B[ordB]

    # ---- sweep 1: term = S(X, qb) = sum_{i<X, j<qb} |A_i - B_j|
    for qv in np.unique(Q):
        L = int(qv) * bsz
        if L <= 0:
            continue
        mask = (Q == qv)
        s = Bs if L == n else Bs[ordB < L]
        cs = np.zeros(L + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(s, out=cs[1:])
        idx = np.searchsorted(s, A, side='right')
        w = A * (2 * idx - L) - 2 * cs[idx] + cs[L]
        W = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(w, out=W[1:])
        ans[mask] += W[X[mask]]

    # ---- sweep 2: term = S(pb, Y) - S(pb, qb)
    for pv in np.unique(P):
        L = int(pv) * bsz
        if L <= 0:
            continue
        mask = (P == pv)
        s = As if L == n else As[ordA < L]
        cs = np.zeros(L + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(s, out=cs[1:])
        idx = np.searchsorted(s, B, side='right')
        v = B * (2 * idx - L) - 2 * cs[idx] + cs[L]
        V = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(v, out=V[1:])
        ans[mask] += V[Y[mask]] - V[QB[mask]]

    # ---- cross terms: partial A block x partial B block
    PBl = PB.tolist()
    QBl = QB.tolist()
    Xl = X.tolist()
    Yl = Y.tolist()
    zero1 = np.zeros(1, dtype=np.int64)
    for t in range(k):
        xa = PBl[t]; xb = Xl[t]
        ya = QBl[t]; yb = Yl[t]
        if xb <= xa or yb <= ya:
            continue
        u = A[xa:xb]
        v = B[ya:yb]
        if u.size > v.size:
            u, v = v, u
        s = np.sort(u)
        cs = np.concatenate((zero1, np.cumsum(s)))
        Ls = s.size
        idx = np.searchsorted(s, v, side='right')
        tot = int((v * (2 * idx - Ls) - 2 * cs[idx]).sum()) + int(cs[Ls]) * int(v.size)
        ans[t] += tot

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(map(str, ans.tolist())) + '\n')

import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    A = np.fromiter(map(int, data[1:1 + n]), dtype=np.int64, count=n)
    B = np.fromiter(map(int, data[1 + n:1 + 2 * n]), dtype=np.int64, count=n)
    k = int(data[1 + 2 * n])
    q0 = 2 + 2 * n
    rest = np.fromiter(map(int, data[q0:q0 + 2 * k]), dtype=np.int64, count=2 * k)
    X = np.ascontiguousarray(rest[0::2])
    Y = np.ascontiguousarray(rest[1::2])

    # block size
    S = max(64, int(n ** 0.5) * 3 + 1)

    ordA = np.argsort(A, kind='stable')
    As = A[ordA]
    Ai = ordA
    ordB = np.argsort(B, kind='stable')
    Bs = B[ordB]
    Bi = ordB

    ans = np.zeros(k, dtype=np.int64)

    bX = (X // S) * S
    bY = (Y // S) * S

    # ---- part 1: sum_{i<=bX, j<=Y} |A_i - B_j| ----
    g1 = defaultdict(list)
    for q in range(k):
        g1[int(bX[q])].append(q)
    for b, qs in g1.items():
        if b == 0:
            continue
        qi = np.array(qs, dtype=np.intp)
        yq = Y[qi]
        m = int(yq.max())
        pref = As[Ai < b]
        cs = np.zeros(b + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(pref, out=cs[1:])
        Bsub = B[:m]
        idx = np.searchsorted(pref, Bsub, side='right')
        g = idx * Bsub - cs[idx] + (cs[b] - cs[idx]) - (b - idx) * Bsub
        C = np.zeros(m + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(g, out=C[1:])
        ans[qi] += C[yq]

    # ---- part 2: sum_{bX<i<=X, j<=bY} |A_i - B_j| ----
    g2 = defaultdict(list)
    for q in range(k):
        g2[int(bY[q])].append(q)
    for c, qs in g2.items():
        if c == 0:
            continue
        qi = np.array(qs, dtype=np.intp)
        xq = X[qi]
        m = int(xq.max())
        pref = Bs[Bi < c]
        cs = np.zeros(c + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(pref, out=cs[1:])
        Asub = A[:m]
        idx = np.searchsorted(pref, Asub, side='right')
        g = idx * Asub - cs[idx] + (cs[c] - cs[idx]) - (c - idx) * Asub
        D = np.zeros(m + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(g, out=D[1:])
        ans[qi] += D[xq] - D[bX[qi]]

    # ---- part 3: sum_{bX<i<=X, bY<j<=Y} |A_i - B_j| ----
    nb = (n + S - 1) // S
    blkAv = []
    blkAi = []
    blkBv = []
    blkBi = []
    for t in range(nb):
        lo = t * S
        hi = min(n, lo + S)
        seg = A[lo:hi]
        o = np.argsort(seg, kind='stable')
        blkAv.append(seg[o])
        blkAi.append(o + lo)
        seg = B[lo:hi]
        o = np.argsort(seg, kind='stable')
        blkBv.append(seg[o])
        blkBi.append(o + lo)

    Xl = X.tolist()
    Yl = Y.tolist()
    for q in range(k):
        x = Xl[q]
        y = Yl[q]
        if x % S == 0 or y % S == 0:
            continue
        t = x // S
        u = y // S
        a = blkAv[t][blkAi[t] < x]
        bb = blkBv[u][blkBi[u] < y]
        qn = bb.size
        cb = np.zeros(qn + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        np.cumsum(bb, out=cb[1:])
        ii = np.searchsorted(bb, a, side='right')
        ans[q] += int((ii * a - cb[ii] + (cb[qn] - cb[ii]) - (qn - ii) * a).sum())

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(map(str, ans.tolist())) + '\n')

        while e < n and X[order_c[e]] == xv:

        col_start[xv] = (pos, e)

    order_r = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: (Y[i], X[i]))

    while pos < n:

        row_start[yv] = (pos, e)

    # DSU "siguiente vivo" para saltar casas ya procesadas (O(alpha) amortizado)
    cpar = list(range(n + 1))
    rpar = list(range(n + 1))

    def find(par, a):
        root = a
        while par[root] != root:
            root = par[root]
        while par[a] != root:
            par[a], a = root, par[a]
        return root

    vis = bytearray(n)
    ans = 0

        if d == b'U' or d == b'D':
            if d == b'U':

            g = col_start.get(x)
            if g is not None:
                s, e = g
                lo = bisect_left(colys, lo_v, s, e)

                if lo < hi:

                    while i < hi:

        else:
            if d == b'R':
                lo_v = x
                hi_v = x + c

            else:
                hi_v = x
                lo_v = x - c
                x = lo_v
            g = row_start.get(y)
            if g is not None:
                s, e = g
                lo = bisect_left(rowxs, lo_v, s, e)
                hi = bisect_right(rowxs, hi_v, s, e)

                    while i < hi:

                            ans += 1
                        rpar[i] = i + 1
                        i = find(rpar, i + 1)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    xs = [0] * n
    hs = [0] * n
    idx = 1
    for i in range(n):
        xs[i] = int(data[idx])
        hs[i] = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2

    if n == 1:
        # Nothing can block the single building.
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n")
        return

    # The minimum height from which building i is visible past building j (j < i) is
    #   (H_j*X_i - H_i*X_j) / (X_i - X_j)
    # i.e. the y-intercept at x=0 of the line through (X_j,H_j) and (X_i,H_i).
    # With u = 1/X, v = H/X that intercept is the slope between (u_j,v_j) and (u_i,v_i),
    # and the maximum slope over all pairs is attained by u-adjacent points, which
    # (since X is strictly increasing) means index-adjacent points.
    best_num = hs[0] * xs[1] - hs[1] * xs[0]
    best_den = xs[1] - xs[0]
    for i in range(1, n - 1):
        num = hs[i] * xs[i + 1] - hs[i + 1] * xs[i]
        den = xs[i + 1] - xs[i]
        # exact comparison: num/den > best_num/best_den  (dens are positive)
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    if best_num < 0:
        # Already possible to see everything at height 0.
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n")
        return

    getcontext().prec = 60
    val = Decimal(best_num) / Decimal(best_den)
    sys.stdout.write("{0:.12f}\n".format(val))

    n = int(data[0])
    xs = [0] * n
    hs = [0] * n
    for k in range(n):
        xs[k] = int(data[1 + 2 * k])
        hs[k] = int(data[2 + 2 * k])

    # Sweep right to left, maintaining the lower convex hull of the suffix.
    # For each j, the minimum slope to any point on its right is attained at
    # the hull vertex on top of the stack after the standard hull pops.
    stx = []
    sth = []
    best_num = None
    best_den = 1

    for j in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        xp = xs[j]
        hp = hs[j]

        while len(stx) >= 2:
            xa = stx[-1]
            ha = sth[-1]
            xb = stx[-2]
            hb = sth[-2]
            # slope(p,a) >= slope(a,b)  <=>  (ha-hp)*(xb-xa) >= (hb-ha)*(xa-xp)
            # (both denominators xa-xp and xb-xa are strictly positive)
            if (ha - hp) * (xb - xa) >= (hb - ha) * (xa - xp):
                stx.pop()
                sth.pop()
            else:
                break

        if stx:
            xi = stx[-1]
            hi = sth[-1]
            # y-intercept at x=0 of the line through (xp,hp) and (xi,hi)
            num = hp * xi - hi * xp
            den = xi - xp  # > 0
            if best_num is None or num * best_den > best_num * den:
                best_num = num
                best_den = den

        stx.append(xp)
        sth.append(hp)

    if best_num is None or best_num < 0:
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write("%.15f\n" % (best_num / best_den))

        # longest common prefix of S[i:] and T[j:]
        L = n - i
        Lj = m - j
        if Lj < L:
            L = Lj
        if L <= 0:
            return 0
        key = (i, j)
        r = cache.get(key)
        if r is not None:
            return r
        p = 0
        step = 1 << 12
        while p < L:
            c = L - p
            if c > step:
                c = step
            a = S[i + p:i + p + c]
            b = T[j + p:j + p + c]
            if a == b:
                p += c
                if step < (1 << 18):
                    step <<= 1
            else:
                x = int.from_bytes(a, 'big') ^ int.from_bytes(b, 'big')
                off = c - ((x.bit_length() + 7) >> 3)
                p += off
                cache[key] = p
                return p
        cache[key] = L
        return L

    NEG = -1
    size = 2 * K + 3
    off = K + 1
    target = m - n

    cur = [NEG] * size
    v0 = lcp(0, 0)
    cur[off] = v0
    if target == 0 and v0 == n:
        sys.stdout.write("Yes\n")
        return

    for d in range(1, K + 1):
        new = [NEG] * size
        for k in range(-d, d + 1):
            idx = k + off
            best = NEG
            # substitution: same diagonal, i+1
            v = cur[idx]
            if v >= 0:
                w = v + 1
                if w <= n and w + k <= m:
                    if w > best:
                        best = w
            # insertion into S (consume T char): from diagonal k-1, same i
            v = cur[idx - 1]
            if v >= 0:
                if v <= n and v + k <= m:
                    if v > best:
                        best = v
            # deletion from S: from diagonal k+1, i+1
            v = cur[idx + 1]
            if v >= 0:

                if w <= n and w + k <= m:
                    if w > best:

            sys.stdout.write("Yes\n")

    sys.stdout.write("No\n")

    n = len(S)
    m = len(T)

    if abs(n - m) > K:
        sys.stdout.write("No\n")

    def lcp(i, j):
        # longest common prefix of S[i:] and T[j:], via doubling + binary search
        rem = n - i
        r2 = m - j
        if r2 < rem:
            rem = r2
        if rem <= 0:
            return 0
        lo = 0
        step = 1
        while step <= rem and S[i:i + step] == T[j:j + step]:
            lo = step
            step <<= 1
        hi = step if step < rem else rem
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1
            if S[i:i + mid] == T[j:j + mid]:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid - 1
        return lo

    # Landau-Vishkin: cur[d + off] = furthest index i in S reachable on
    # diagonal d = j - i using exactly e edits (j is index in T).
    NEG = -(1 << 40)
    off = K + 1
    size = 2 * K + 3
    dg = m - n

    cur = [NEG] * size
    cur[off] = lcp(0, 0)
    if dg == 0 and cur[off] >= n:
        sys.stdout.write("Yes\n")
        return

    for e in range(1, K + 1):
        new = [NEG] * size
        for d in range(-e, e + 1):
            idx = d + off
            best = NEG
            # substitution: stay on diagonal d, advance both
            i0 = cur[idx]
            if 0 <= i0 < n and i0 + d < m:
                if i0 + 1 > best:
                    best = i0 + 1
            # deletion in S: comes from diagonal d+1, advance i only
            i0 = cur[idx + 1]
            if 0 <= i0 < n:
                if i0 + 1 > best:
                    best = i0 + 1
            # insertion in S: comes from diagonal d-1, advance j only
            i0 = cur[idx - 1]
            if i0 >= 0 and i0 + d - 1 < m:
                if i0 > best:
                    best = i0
            if best < 0:
                continue
            i = best
            j = i + d
            if j < 0 or j > m or i > n:
                continue
            new[idx] = i + lcp(i, j)
        cur = new
        if -e <= dg <= e and cur[dg + off] >= n:
            sys.stdout.write("Yes\n")

    state = [0] * (n + 1)          # 0 sin visitar, 1 en curso, 2 terminado

    for s in range(1, n + 1):

            continue
        path = []
        u = s
        while state[u] == 0:
            state[u] = 1
            path.append(u)
            u = A[u]
        if state[u] == 1:
            idx = path.index(u)
            cyc = path[idx:]
            r = cyc[0]
            for w in cyc:
                oncycle[w] = True
                rep[w] = r
        for w in path:
            state[w] = 2

    # --- construir el bosque: raiz = ciclo contraido, hijo <= padre ---
    children = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    parent = [0] * (n + 1)
    roots = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if oncycle[i]:
            if rep[i] == i:
                roots.append(i)
                parent[i] = 0
        else:
            p = rep[A[i]]
            parent[i] = p
            children[p].append(i)

    # orden desde las raices (procesaremos al reves: hijos antes que padres)
    order = []
    stack = roots[:]
    while stack:
        u = stack.pop()
        order.append(u)
        for c in children[u]:
            stack.append(c)

    acc = [None] * (n + 1)
    ans = 1
    for u in reversed(order):
        a = acc[u]
        if a is None:
            a = [1] * m

        for v in range(m):

            if s >= MOD:

        p = parent[u]
        if p:

            if pa is None:
                acc[p] = a
            else:
                for v in range(m):
                    pa[v] = pa[v] * a[v] % MOD
        else:
            ans = ans * a[m - 1] % MOD

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    N = int(data[0]); M = int(data[1])
    A = [0] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        A[i] = int(data[1 + i])

    # --- find cycles in the functional graph i -> A[i] ---
    state = [0] * (N + 1)          # 0 unvisited, 1 on current path, 2 done
    oncycle = [False] * (N + 1)
    rep = list(range(N + 1))       # representative node (cycle nodes collapse to one)

    for s in range(1, N + 1):
        if state[s] != 0:
            continue
        path = []
        pos = {}
        u = s
        while state[u] == 0:
            state[u] = 1
            pos[u] = len(path)
            path.append(u)
            u = A[u]
        if state[u] == 1:
            # cycle found: path[pos[u]:]
            r = u
            for w in path[pos[u]:]:
                oncycle[w] = True
                rep[w] = r
        for w in path:
            state[w] = 2

    # --- build contracted forest: parent of i is rep[A[i]] ---
    children = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    roots = []
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        if oncycle[i]:
            if rep[i] == i:
                roots.append(i)
        else:
            children[rep[A[i]]].append(i)

    pref = {}
    ans = 1

    for root in roots:
        # iterative DFS to get an order; reversed order is a valid post-order
        order = []
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            v = stack.pop()
            order.append(v)
            ch = children[v]
            if ch:
                stack.extend(ch)

        for v in reversed(order):
            g = [1] * (M + 1)
            g[0] = 0
            for c in children[v]:
                pc = pref.pop(c)
                g = [(a * b) % MOD for a, b in zip(g, pc)]
            pv = list(accumulate(g, lambda a, b: (a + b) % MOD))
            pref[v] = pv

        ans = (ans * pref.pop(root)[M]) % MOD

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans % MOD) + "\n")

        rows.append(r)

    def build(rws):
        # Split the 20-bit state into two 10-bit halves; tabulate the OR of the rows.
        lo = [0] * 1024
        for m in range(1, 1024):
            lb = m & -m
            idx = lb.bit_length() - 1
            lo[m] = (rws[idx] if idx < B else 0) | lo[m ^ lb]
        hi = [0] * 1024
        for m in range(1, 1024):
            lb = m & -m
            idx = lb.bit_length() - 1 + 10
            hi[m] = (rws[idx] if idx < B else 0) | hi[m ^ lb]
        return lo, hi

    nbits = max(N.bit_length(), 1) + 2
    pows = []
    cur_rows = rows
    for _ in range(nbits):
        lo, hi = build(cur_rows)
        pows.append((lo, hi))
        # square the matrix: (T*T)[k] = OR of T[j] for j in bits of T[k]
        cur_rows = [lo[r & 1023] | hi[r >> 10] for r in cur_rows]

    def advance(state, n):
        i = 0
        while n:
            if n & 1:
                lo, hi = pows[i]
                state = lo[state & 1023] | hi[state >> 10]
                if state == 0:
                    return 0
            n >>= 1
            i += 1
        return state

    cur = 1
    state = 1  # reach[1] = True

    ok = True
    for (L, R) in intervals:
        if R < cur or L <= cur:
            # Should not happen given the constraints (1 < L, R < N, disjoint & sorted).
            continue
        gap = (L - 1) - cur
        if gap > 0:
            state = advance(state, gap)
            if state == 0:
                ok = False
                break
        blen = R - L + 1
        if blen >= B:
            state = 0
        else:
            state = (state << blen) & full
        if state == 0:
            ok = False
            break
        cur = R

    if ok:
        rest = N - cur
        if rest > 0:
            state = advance(state, rest)
        print("Yes" if (state & 1) else "No")
    else:
        print("No")

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0]); M = int(data[1]); A = int(data[2]); B = int(data[3])
    iv = []
    idx = 4
    for _ in range(M):
        L = int(data[idx]); R = int(data[idx + 1]); idx += 2
        iv.append((L, R))
    iv.sort()

    full = (1 << B) - 1
    lim = 1 << (A - 1)   # m & (bits A-1..B-1) != 0  <=>  m >= 2^(A-1)

    cache = {}
    budget = [400000]

    def get_info(m):
        info = cache.get(m)
        if info is not None:
            return info
        traj = []
        seen = {m: 0}
        x = m
        while True:
            x = ((x << 1) & full) | (1 if x >= lim else 0)
            traj.append(x)
            if x == full or x == 0:
                info = (traj, -1, 0)
                break
            prev = seen.get(x)
            if prev is not None:
                info = (traj, prev, len(traj) - prev)
                break
            seen[x] = len(traj)
        if budget[0] >= len(traj):
            budget[0] -= len(traj)
            cache[m] = info
        return info

    def advance(m, ln):
        # advance over ln consecutive free squares
        if ln <= 0 or m == 0 or m == full:
            return m
        traj, start, period = get_info(m)
        n = len(traj)
        if ln <= n:
            return traj[ln - 1]
        if start < 0:
            return traj[-1]
        r = start + (ln - start) % period
        return m if r == 0 else traj[r - 1]

    cur = 1
    m = 1  # bit i of m  <=>  square (cur - i) is reachable
    for L, R in iv:
        ln = R - L + 1
        if ln >= B:
            sys.stdout.write("No\n")
            return
        m = advance(m, L - 1 - cur)
        if m == 0:
            sys.stdout.write("No\n")
            return
        m = (m << ln) & full
        if m == 0:
            sys.stdout.write("No\n")
            return
        cur = R
    m = advance(m, N - cur)
    sys.stdout.write("Yes\n" if (m & 1) else "No\n")

    sp = np.zeros((LOG, n), dtype=np.int32)

        length = n - (1 << j) + 1
        if length <= 0:
            break
        sp[j, :length] = np.maximum(sp[j - 1, :length], sp[j - 1, half:half + length])

    LOGTAB = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    for j in range(1, LOG + 1):
        start = 1 << j
        if start > n:
            break
        end = min(n + 1, 1 << (j + 1))
        LOGTAB[start:end] = j

    S = R - L + 1
    lo = np.zeros(q, dtype=np.int64)
    hi = S // 2

    # feasible(K) <=> max D[L .. L+K-1] <= S - K   (and K <= S//2)

        m = np.maximum(sp[j, i1], sp[j, i2])

        lo = np.where(ok, midc, lo)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()

    M = 500000          # max rating value / max query X
    SIZE = M + 1        # sentinel index (guards the right end)
    N2 = 524288         # power of two >= SIZE
    BIG = 1 << 45

    # a[i] = current rating of someone who started at i (non-decreasing in i).
    # b[i] = a[i] - a[i-1] >= 0 kept in a Fenwick tree, so prefix(i) = a[i].
    # Initially a[i] = i  ->  b[i] = 1 for every i, i.e. tree[i] = i & -i.
    tree = [i & -i for i in range(N2 + 1)]
    # sentinel: b[SIZE] = BIG so the descent never walks past index M
    p = SIZE
    delta = BIG - 1
    while p <= N2:
        tree[p] += delta
        p += p & -p

    diff = [0] * (SIZE + 2)   # plain difference array to answer queries at the end

    ptr = 1
    for _ in range(n):
        L = int(data[ptr]); R = int(data[ptr + 1]); ptr += 2

        # lo = first index with a[i] >= L  ==  (last index with a[i] <= L-1) + 1
        v = L - 1
        pos = 0
        k = 262144
        while k:
            t = tree[pos + k]
            if t <= v:
                pos += k
                v -= t
            k >>= 1
        lo = pos + 1

        # hi = last index with a[i] <= R
        v = R
        pos = 0
        k = 262144
        while k:
            t = tree[pos + k]
            if t <= v:
                pos += k
                v -= t
            k >>= 1
        hi = pos

        if lo <= hi:
            diff[lo] += 1
            diff[hi + 1] -= 1
            p = lo
            while p <= N2:
                tree[p] += 1
                p += p & -p
            p = hi + 1
            while p <= N2:
                tree[p] -= 1
                p += p & -p

    q = int(data[ptr]); ptr += 1
    cum = list(accumulate(diff))

    res = []
    ap = res.append
    for i in range(ptr, ptr + q):
        x = int(data[i])

    MAXX = 500000          # posiciones (ratings iniciales) 1..500000
    PW0 = 262144           # mayor potencia de 2 <= MAXX
    tree = [0] * (MAXX + 1)  # Fenwick de diferencias: prefix(x) = incrementos de x

    for _ in range(n):
        L = int(data[p]); R = int(data[p + 1]); p += 2

        # lo = menor x con g(x) >= L   (g(x) = x + prefix(x), no decreciente)
        pos = 0; s = 0; pw = PW0
        while pw:
            nxt = pos + pw
            if nxt <= MAXX:
                t = s + tree[nxt]
                if nxt + t < L:
                    pos = nxt; s = t
            pw >>= 1
        lo = pos + 1

        # hi = mayor x con g(x) <= R
        pos = 0; s = 0; pw = PW0
        while pw:
            nxt = pos + pw
            if nxt <= MAXX:
                t = s + tree[nxt]
                if nxt + t <= R:
                    pos = nxt; s = t
            pw >>= 1
        hi = pos

        if lo <= hi:
            i = lo
            while i <= MAXX:
                tree[i] += 1
                i += i & -i
            i = hi + 1
            while i <= MAXX:
                tree[i] -= 1
                i += i & -i

    # Fenwick -> array de diferencias, y luego sumas prefijas de una pasada
    for i in range(MAXX, 0, -1):
        j = i + (i & -i)
        if j <= MAXX:
            tree[j] -= tree[i]
    pref = list(accumulate(tree))

        r = 0
        prev = 0
        for p in S:
            g = p - prev - 1
            r += g * (g + 1) // 2
            prev = p
        g = n - prev
        r += g * (g + 1) // 2
        return r

    av = [0] * (n + 2)
    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        av[v] = avoid(pos[v])

    # ---- Part 2: subtract, for each v, #subarrays containing both v-1 and v ----
    sub = 0

        P = pos[v - 1]
        Q = pos[v]
        if not P or not Q:

        merged = P + Q

def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])

    # Group numbers 1..N by their number of decimal digits L.
    # groups: (L, count, sum_of_values mod MOD, 10^L mod MOD)
    groups = []
    low = 1
    L = 1
    while low <= N:
        high = low * 10 - 1
        if high > N:
            high = N
        c = high - low + 1
        ssum = (low + high) * c // 2 % MOD
        groups.append((L, c, ssum, pow(10, L, MOD)))
        low *= 10
        L += 1
    m = len(groups)  # m <= 6 for N <= 2*10^5

    # P(z) = prod_L (1 + 10^L z)^{c_L}
    # R(z) = prod over distinct L of (1 + 10^L z)          (degree m)
    # U(z) = sum_L c_L*10^L * prod_{M!=L} (1 + 10^M z)     (degree m-1)
    # Logarithmic derivative:  P'(z) * R(z) = P(z) * U(z)
    R = [1]
    for g in groups:
        a = g[3]
        nR = R + [0]
        for i in range(len(R)):
            nR[i + 1] = (nR[i + 1] + R[i] * a) % MOD
        R = nR

    U = [0] * m
    for idx in range(m):
        Q = [1]
        for j in range(m):
            if j == idx:
                continue
            a = groups[j][3]
            nQ = Q + [0]
            for i in range(len(Q)):
                nQ[i + 1] = (nQ[i + 1] + Q[i] * a) % MOD
            Q = nQ
        coef = groups[idx][1] % MOD * groups[idx][3] % MOD
        for i in range(len(Q)):
            U[i] = (U[i] + coef * Q[i]) % MOD

    # modular inverses 1..N
    inv = [0] * (N + 1)
    if N >= 1:
        inv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, N + 1):
        inv[i] = (MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD) % MOD

    # Coefficient recurrence from P'*R = P*U:
    #   sum_{j=0}^{m} r_j (n+1-j) p_{n+1-j} = sum_{j=0}^{m-1} u_j p_{n-j},  r_0 = 1
    u = U + [0] * (6 - m)
    r = R + [0] * (7 - len(R))
    u0, u1, u2, u3, u4, u5 = u[0], u[1], u[2], u[3], u[4], u[5]
    r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6 = r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6]

    # q is p shifted by 6 so that negative indices read as zero
    q = [0] * (N + 7)
    q[6] = 1
    for n in range(N):
        b = n + 6
        qb = q[b]
        q1 = q[b - 1]
        q2 = q[b - 2]
        q3 = q[b - 3]
        q4 = q[b - 4]
        q5 = q[b - 5]
        s = (u0 * qb + u1 * q1 + u2 * q2 + u3 * q3 + u4 * q4 + u5 * q5
             - r1 * n * qb - r2 * (n - 1) * q1 - r3 * (n - 2) * q2
             - r4 * (n - 3) * q3 - r5 * (n - 4) * q4 - r6 * (n - 5) * q5) % MOD
        q[b + 1] = s * inv[n + 1] % MOD
    p = q[6:]  # p[0..N], coefficients of P(z)

    fact = [1] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD

    # weight for a suffix set of size k: k! * (N-1-k)!
    w = [fact[k] * fact[N - 1 - k] % MOD for k in range(N)]

    ans = 0
    for g in groups:
        a = g[3]
        ssum = g[2]
        # A(z) = P(z) / (1 + a z): subsets of the other N-1 numbers
        cur = 1  # A_0
        tot = w[0]
        for k in range(1, N):
            cur = (p[k] - a * cur) % MOD
            tot = (tot + w[k] * cur) % MOD
        ans = (ans + ssum * tot) % MOD

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans % MOD) + "\n")

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(300000)

    n = int(data[0])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]

    # A_i <= 1e18 < 2^60, so every A has zero bits at positions >= 60 and all
    # residues mod 2^60 are already distinct.  CAP is a safe cut-off: from depth
    # 61 on, the remaining set is a singleton and can always be flushed within
    # three more levels, so nothing optimal survives past CAP.
    CAP = 70
    NLEV = CAP + 5

    # cnts[j][r] = #{k : A_k mod 2^j == r}
    cnts = []
    for j in range(NLEV):
        mask = (1 << j) - 1
        d = {}
        for a in A:
            key = a & mask
            d[key] = d.get(key, 0) + 1
        cnts.append(d)

    memo = {}

    def rec(j, r):
        # State: bits 0..j-1 of i are fixed; r = (-i) mod 2^j is the common
        # residue of the still-undecided A's.  V = set with residue r (creases
        # i+A still == 0 mod 2^j), D = sibling set (residue r ^ 2^(j-1)), whose
        # creases have lowest set bit exactly j-1 and whose mountain/valley
        # status is decided by the bit b_j chosen right now.
        # Returns the max number of mountains from D plus everything in V,
        # or -1 if this branch cannot flush V (invalid).
        key = (j, r)
        v = memo.get(key)
        if v is not None:
            return v

        cj = cnts[j]
        nV = cj.get(r, 0)
        half = 1 << (j - 1)
        rD = r ^ half
        nD = cj.get(rD, 0)

        if nV == 0 and nD == 0:
            memo[key] = 0
            return 0
        if nV > 0 and j >= CAP:
            memo[key] = -1
            return -1

        # carry into bit j-1 for the parent set, and the carry out of bit j-1
        # for the dropped group D (1 only when b_{j-1} = 1 and c_{j-1} = 1)
        c_prev = 1 if (r & (half - 1)) else 0
        if c_prev:
            cpp = 1 ^ ((r >> (j - 1)) & 1)
        else:
            cpp = 0
        # carry into bit j for the continuing set
        c = 1 if r else 0

        cn = cnts[j + 1]
        bit = 1 << j
        best = -1
        for b in (0, 1):
            # D element is a mountain iff bit_j(i+A) == 1, i.e.
            # bit_j(A) == 1 ^ b ^ cpp
            xA = 1 ^ b ^ cpp
            gain = cn.get(rD + (xA * bit), 0)
            sub = rec(j + 1, r + ((b ^ c) * bit))
            if sub < 0:
                continue
            t = gain + sub
            if t > best:
                best = t

        memo[key] = best
        return best

    ans = max(rec(1, 0), rec(1, 1))
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")


main()

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]

    sys.setrecursionlimit(100000)

    # Crease x (1-indexed from the left) is a MOUNTAIN fold iff
    #     (x >> v2(x)) % 4 == 3
    # i.e. the binary representation of x ends with "11" followed by zeros.
    # This predicate is invariant under multiplication by powers of two, which
    # makes the problem self-similar over the bits of i.
    #
    # W(V, b): we still have to pick j = b + 2*j' (b already fixed, j' free,
    # j' >= 0) and we score  #{ v in V : mountain(v + j) }.
    #   - v + b odd  -> v2 is 0 at this level, the element "leaves"; it is a
    #     mountain iff the next bit makes ((v + b) >> 1 + j') odd, i.e. it
    #     depends only on the parity of (v + b) >> 1 versus the parity of j'.
    #   - v + b even -> v + j = 2 * ((v + b) / 2 + j'), and mountain() is
    #     scale invariant, so the same problem recurses with the halved value.
    # A single remaining value can always be completed to a mountain number of
    # either parity (odd ones are 3 mod 4, even ones are 2 * mountain), so its
    # answer is 1 no matter what the next bit is.
    def W(V, b):
        if not V:
            return 0
        if len(V) == 1:
            return 1
        leave = []
        surv = []
        for v in V:
            s = v + b
            if s & 1:
                leave.append(s >> 1)
            else:
                surv.append(s >> 1)
        c0 = 0
        for w in leave:
            if not (w & 1):
                c0 += 1
        c1 = len(leave) - c0
        if not surv:
            return c0 if c0 > c1 else c1
        r0 = W(surv, 0)
        r1 = W(surv, 1)
        x = c1 + r0
        y = c0 + r1
        return x if x > y else y

    ans = max(W(A, 0), W(A, 1))
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")

    G_arr = [[-1] * (n + 2) for _ in range(n + 2)]
    H_arr = [[n + 2] * (n + 3) for _ in range(n + 2)]
    for xp in range(1, n + 1):

        for xi in range(xp - 2, -1, -1):

                g = qy
            row[xi] = g
        rowh = H_arr[xp]
        h = n + 2
        rowh[yp + 1] = n + 2
        for yi in range(yp + 2, n + 2):
            qx = X[yi - 1]
            if qx > xp and qx < h:
                h = qx
            rowh[yi] = h

    # corners: x=0 is L=(0,n+1), x=1..n are the real points, x=n+1 is R=(n+1,0)

    Yc[0] = n + 1
    for x in range(1, n + 1):

    Yc[n + 1] = 0

    sz = 1

        sz *= 2

    dp = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp[0] = 1

    for xi in range(0, n + 1):
        cur = dp[xi]
        if cur == 0:

        yi = Yc[xi]
        tree = [0] * (2 * sz)

        # mark, for every point p that could sit inside a box starting at corner i,
        # the rectangle of right corners j for which p would be isolated in that box
        for xp in range(xi + 1, n + 1):

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    MOD = 998244353

    posY = [0] * (n + 2)   # posY[x] = y
    posX = [0] * (n + 2)   # posX[y] = x
    idx = 1
    for _ in range(n):
        x = int(data[idx]); y = int(data[idx + 1]); idx += 2
        posY[x] = y
        posX[y] = x

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # Teoria:
    #  - Los balones elegidos forman siempre una ANTICADENA (staircase):
    #    x creciente, y decreciente. El conjunto final es K union los
    #    puntos estrictamente dentro de las "cajas" del staircase:
    #        B_t = (x_t, x_{t+1}) x (y_{t+1}, y_t)
    #    con puntos virtuales p_0=(0,N+1) y p_{m+1}=(N+1,0).
    #  - Dos staircases dan el mismo conjunto S si difieren solo en
    #    puntos "aislados" dentro de una caja (incomparables con todos
    #    los demas de su caja). El representante canonico (K = g(S)) es
    #    aquel en el que NINGUNA caja contiene un punto aislado.
    #  - Puntos de cajas distintas son siempre incomparables entre si,
    #    asi que el aislamiento solo depende de la propia caja.
    #  - p en la caja (j,k) es aislado  <=>
    #        rect (x_j, X_p) x (y_k, Y_p) vacio   <=> M3(p,x_j) <= y_k
    #        rect (X_p, x_k) x (Y_p, y_j) vacio   <=> x_k <= M4(p,y_j)
    #    => para j fijo, los k "malos" que aporta p son un RECTANGULO:
    #        X_p < x_k <= M4(p,y_j)   y   M3(p,x_j) <= y_k < Y_p
    #  - Se cuenta con DP sobre el staircase los caminos p_0 -> p_{m+1}
    #    con todas las cajas validas.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------

    # M3[a][L] = max{ Y_q : L < X_q < a, Y_q < posY[a] }  (0 si no hay)
    M3 = [None] * (n + 2)
    for a in range(1, n + 1):
        b = posY[a]
        row = [0] * (n + 2)
        cur = 0
        for L in range(a - 2, -1, -1):
            yq = posY[L + 1]
            if yq < b and yq > cur:
                cur = yq
            row[L] = cur
        M3[a] = row

    # M4[a][T] = min{ X_q : X_q > a, posY[a] < Y_q < T }  (n+1 si no hay)
    M4 = [None] * (n + 2)
    for a in range(1, n + 1):
        b = posY[a]
        row = [n + 1] * (n + 3)
        cur = n + 1
        for T in range(b + 2, n + 2):
            xq = posX[T - 1]
            if xq > a and xq < cur:
                cur = xq
            row[T] = cur
        M4[a] = row

    # candidatos k: indice i = x-1 para puntos reales (x=1..n),
    #               indice n para el virtual (x=n+1, y=0)
    K = n + 1
    ALL = (1 << K) - 1

    ky = [0] * K
    for i in range(n):
        ky[i] = posY[i + 1]
    ky[n] = 0

    bits_by_y = [0] * (n + 2)
    for i in range(K):
        bits_by_y[ky[i]] |= (1 << i)

    # ymask[v] = bits de k con y_k < v
    ymask = [0] * (n + 3)
    acc = 0
    for v in range(0, n + 3):
        ymask[v] = acc
        if v <= n + 1:
            acc |= bits_by_y[v]

    f = [0] * K

    for a in range(0, n + 1):
        if a == 0:
            fj = 1
            xj = 0
            yj = n + 1
        else:
            fj = f[a - 1]
            if fj == 0:
                continue
            xj = a
            yj = posY[a]

        bad = 0
        for xp in range(xj + 1, n + 1):
            yp = posY[xp]
            if yp >= yj:
                continue
            m3 = M3[xp][xj]
            m4 = M4[xp][yj]
            mx = ((1 << (m4 - xp)) - 1) << xp          # x_k en (xp, m4]
            my = ymask[yp] & ~ymask[m3]                # y_k en [m3, yp)
            bad |= mx & my

        allowed = ALL & ~((1 << xj) - 1) & ymask[yj]
        valid = allowed & ~bad

        m = valid
        while m:
            bl = m & (-m)
            i = bl.bit_length() - 1
            m ^= bl
            f[i] = (f[i] + fj) % MOD

    sys.stdout.write(str(f[n] % MOD) + "\n")

            if mm > 1:
                mask = (1 << mm) - 1
                x = 0
                p = 1
                while p < mm:
                    if (b >> p) & 1:
                        b = (b ^ (b << p)) & mask
                        x += p
                    p <<= 1
                d = 1 << (mm - 1).bit_length()
                X = (-x) % d
            else:
                X = 0
            r = ((e, b), X)
            memo[a] = r
        key, X = r
        g = groups.get(key)
        if g is None:
            groups[key] = [X]
        else:
            g.append(X)

    total = 0
    for (e, _c), vals in groups.items():
        k = len(vals)

            continue

        if mm <= 1:
            continue
        d = 1 << (mm - 1).bit_length()
        if d == 1:
            continue
        S = 0
        coef = k - 1
        for v in vals:
            S += v * coef
            coef -= 2
        cnt = [0] * d
        C = 0
        for v in vals:
            if v:

            cnt[v] += 1
        total = (total + S + d * C) % MOD

    sys.stdout.write(str(total % MOD) + "\n")

import numpy as np

MOD = 998244353


def _spx(mat, d):
    # multiply each row (as poly over F2) by (1+t^d)^{-1}  == stride-d prefix xor
    r, m = mat.shape
    nb = -(-m // d)
    tot = nb * d
    if tot == m:
        v = mat.copy().reshape(r, nb, d)
        np.bitwise_xor.accumulate(v, axis=1, out=v)
        return v.reshape(r, m)
    buf = np.zeros((r, tot), dtype=mat.dtype)
    buf[:, :m] = mat
    v = buf.reshape(r, nb, d)
    np.bitwise_xor.accumulate(v, axis=1, out=v)
    return buf[:, :m]


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    L = len(data)
    ws = b' \t\r\n'
    i = 0
    head = []
    for _ in range(2):
        while i < L and data[i] in ws:
            i += 1
        j = i
        while j < L and data[j] not in ws:
            j += 1
        head.append(int(data[i:j]))
        i = j
    N, M = head[0], head[1]

    raw = np.frombuffer(data, dtype=np.uint8, offset=i)
    m01 = (raw == 48) | (raw == 49)
    vals = raw[m01]
    need = N * M
    vals = vals[:need] - np.uint8(48)
    A = vals.reshape(N, M)

    # sequences that are all zero never contribute (f = 0 with everybody)
    nzrow = A.any(axis=1)
    idx = np.nonzero(nzrow)[0]
    n = idx.size
    if n < 2:
        sys.stdout.write("0\n")
        return

    firstone = A.argmax(axis=1)
    aval = firstone[idx].astype(np.int64)
    order = np.argsort(aval, kind='stable')
    idx = idx[order]
    aval = aval[order]

    keys = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    phases = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    Pof = np.ones(n, dtype=np.int64)
    gcount = 0

    bnd = np.nonzero(np.concatenate(([True], aval[1:] != aval[:-1])))[0]
    ends = np.concatenate((bnd[1:], [n]))

    for bi in range(bnd.size):
        st = int(bnd[bi]); en = int(ends[bi])
        a = int(aval[st])
        k = en - st
        m = M - a
        s = (m - 1).bit_length()      # ceil(log2 m); order of (1+t) mod t^m is 2^s
        P = 1 << s
        Pof[st:en] = P
        if k == 1:
            keys[st] = gcount
            gcount += 1
            continue
        rows = idx[st:en]
        B = np.ascontiguousarray(A[rows, a:])
        x = np.zeros(k, dtype=np.int64)
        for kk in range(s):
            d = 1 << kk
            col = B[:, d].astype(np.int64)          # copy before modifying B
            x += col << kk
            selr = col.astype(bool)
            c = int(selr.sum())
            if c == 0:
                continue
            full = _spx(B, d)
            if c == k:
                B = full
            else:
                np.copyto(B, full, where=selr[:, None])
        packed = np.packbits(B, axis=1)
        uq, ginv = np.unique(packed, axis=0, return_inverse=True)
        ginv = np.asarray(ginv).reshape(-1).astype(np.int64)
        keys[st:en] = ginv + gcount
        gcount += int(uq.shape[0])
        phases[st:en] = x

    # group everything by canonical key; within a key rows stay in input order
    o = np.argsort(keys, kind='stable')
    K = keys[o]
    Y = phases[o]
    PP = Pof[o]

    startmask = np.concatenate(([True], K[1:] != K[:-1]))
    gs = np.nonzero(startmask)[0]
    sizes = np.diff(np.concatenate((gs, [n])))

    pos = np.arange(n, dtype=np.int64)
    rank = pos - np.repeat(gs, sizes).astype(np.int64)
    szrep = np.repeat(sizes, sizes).astype(np.int64)
    coef = szrep - 1 - 2 * rank
    S1 = int(np.dot(Y, coef))
    ans = S1 % MOD

    Yl = Y.tolist()
    Pl = PP.tolist()
    gsl = gs.tolist()
    szl = sizes.tolist()
    for gi in range(len(gsl)):
        sz = szl[gi]
        if sz < 2:
            continue
        st = gsl[gi]
        P = Pl[st]
        if P == 1:
            continue
        yy = Yl[st:st + sz]
        if max(yy) == min(yy):
            continue
        cnt = [0] * P
        tot = 0
        for v in yy:
            if v:
                tot += sum(cnt[:v])
            cnt[v] += 1
        if tot:
            ans = (ans + (P % MOD) * (tot % MOD)) % MOD

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans % MOD) + "\n")

import sys
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); X = int(data[1])
    A = np.fromiter(map(int, data[2:2 + n]), dtype=np.int64, count=n)

    # counts capped at 3 (never need more than 3 copies of a value)
    cnt = np.bincount(A, minlength=X + 1)[:X + 1]
    c = np.minimum(cnt, 3).astype(np.int64)
    # a value v can only be part of a triple if v <= X-2 (other two are >= 1)
    if X >= 2:
        c[X - 1:] = 0
    else:
        c[:] = 0
    if int(c.sum()) < 3:
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n"); return

    # self-convolution -> for each s, number of ordered index pairs summing to s
    n2 = 2 * X + 1
    nfft = 1 << (n2 - 1).bit_length()
    F = np.fft.rfft(c.astype(np.float64), nfft)
    conv = np.fft.irfft(F * F, nfft)[:X + 1]
    convi = np.rint(conv).astype(np.int64)

    diag = np.zeros(X + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    diag[::2] = c[:X // 2 + 1]
    P = (convi - diag) // 2  # unordered pairs of distinct indices summing to s

    ar = np.arange(X + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    Pv = P[::-1]                      # Pv[a] = P[X-a]
    d = X - 2 * ar                    # partner value of the removed copy of a
    valid = d >= 0
    dc = np.where(valid, c[np.clip(d, 0, X)], 0)
    dc = dc - ((d == ar) & valid)     # pairs that use the removed copy of a
    good = (c > 0) & ((Pv - dc) > 0)
    cand = np.flatnonzero(good)
    if cand.size == 0:
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n"); return

    a = int(cand[0])
    T = X - a
    cc = c.copy()
    cc[a] -= 1
    lo = max(0, T - X)
    hi = T // 2
    bs = np.arange(lo, hi + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    ok = (cc[bs] >= 1) & (cc[T - bs] >= 1)
    if T % 2 == 0 and hi >= lo:
        ok[-1] = cc[hi] >= 2
    w = np.flatnonzero(ok)
    if w.size == 0:
        sys.stdout.write("-1\n"); return
    b = int(bs[int(w[0])])
    e = T - b

    picked = []
    for v, k in Counter([a, b, e]).items():
        pos = np.flatnonzero(A == v)[:k]
        picked.extend(int(t) + 1 for t in pos)
    picked.sort()
    sys.stdout.write("%d %d %d\n" % (picked[0], picked[1], picked[2]))

def main():

    x = int(data[1])

    if cnt.size > x + 1:
        cnt = cnt[:x + 1]

    ans_vals = None

    # Case A: three copies of the same value
    if x % 3 == 0 and cnt[x // 3] >= 3:
        v = x // 3
        ans_vals = (v, v, v)

    # Case B: exactly two equal (2*a + c = x, c != a)
    if ans_vals is None:
        half = (x - 1) // 2
        if half >= 1:
            av = np.arange(1, half + 1, dtype=np.int64)
            cv = x - 2 * av
            ok = (cnt[av] >= 2) & (cnt[cv] >= 1) & (cv != av)
            w = np.flatnonzero(ok)
            if w.size:
                a0 = int(av[w[0]])
                c0 = x - 2 * a0
                ans_vals = (a0, a0, c0)

    # Case C: three pairwise distinct values
    if ans_vals is None:
        lim = x - 2
        pv = np.zeros(x + 1, dtype=bool)
        if lim >= 1:
            pv[1:lim + 1] = cnt[1:lim + 1] > 0

        if pv.any():
            p = pv.astype(np.float64)
            size = 1
            while size < 2 * x + 2:
                size <<= 1
            f = np.fft.rfft(p, size)
            conv = np.fft.irfft(f * f, size)
            conv = np.rint(conv[:x + 1]).astype(np.int64)
            # drop the a == b diagonal so only ordered pairs of distinct values remain
            ev = np.arange(0, x + 1, 2, dtype=np.int64)
            conv[ev] -= pv[ev // 2].astype(np.int64)
            pairs = conv // 2  # unordered pairs {a,b}, a != b, both present, a+b = s

            cs = np.flatnonzero(pv)
            ss = x - cs
            valid = ss >= 3
            ssc = np.where(valid, ss, 0)
            pa = pairs[ssc]
            t = x - 2 * cs
            tc = np.clip(t, 0, x)
            contains = (t >= 1) & (t != cs) & pv[tc]
            good = valid & ((pa >= 2) | ((pa == 1) & (~contains)))
            g = np.flatnonzero(good)

            for gi in g[:5]:
                c0 = int(cs[gi])
                s = x - c0
                m = s // 2
                if m < 1:
                    continue
                aa = np.arange(1, m + 1, dtype=np.int64)
                bb = s - aa
                ok2 = pv[aa] & pv[bb] & (aa != bb) & (aa != c0) & (bb != c0)
                w2 = np.flatnonzero(ok2)
                if w2.size:
                    a0 = int(aa[w2[0]])
                    b0 = s - a0
                    ans_vals = (a0, b0, c0)
                    break

    if ans_vals is None:
        out.write("-1\n")
        return

    need = {}
    for v in ans_vals:
        need[v] = need.get(v, 0) + 1
    res = []
    for v, k in need.items():
        pos = np.flatnonzero(A == v)[:k]
        for z in pos:
            res.append(int(z) + 1)
    res.sort()
    out.write(" ".join(map(str, res)) + "\n")
